item.title: Brock Faber: Begins season on IR
item.description:
Faber (upper body) will begin the 2026-27 regular season on injured reserve, per Dylan Loucks of The Hockey News.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Elvis Merzlikins: Shipped to Toronto
item.description:
Merzlikins (shoulder), Kirill Marchenko and Miles Wood were traded to the Maple Leafs from the Blue Jackets on Monday in exchange for Matthew Knies, Steven Lorentz, Emil Andrae and a second-round pick, Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Filip Gustavsson: Moves to injured reserve
item.description:

item.title: Matthew Knies: Shipped to Columbus
item.description:
